name: TideReply – AI Customer Chat for WooCommerce
author: tidereply

sections.description:
TideReply answers your customers in seconds, from your own website, files and FAQs, in the language they write in. When a question needs a person, it says so and brings your team into the same chat. Every customer answered. Only the hard ones reach you.

What your customers get

  • Answers from your store, not guesses – shipping, returns, sizing, payments: TideReply reads your site and the files you add, and answers from that. When it does not know, it does not make something up.
  • Real order status – with WooCommerce, a shopper asks “where is my order?” and gets its fulfillment status and tracking. The order number and checkout email are checked on your own server first.
  • Their own language – it detects the language a visitor writes in and answers in it. No translation setup.
  • A person when it matters – the hard questions go to your team in the same conversation, with the summary already written.

What you get

  • One inbox in TideReply for website chat, email, Messenger and Instagram.
  • Fewer repeat questions, and more time for the ones that need you.
  • Setup in a few minutes: install, connect, approve. No code, no theme editing.

How it works

  1. Install and activate this plugin.
  2. Click “Connect TideReply” in the notice, or go to Settings, TideReply and click “Connect to TideReply”.
  3. Sign in to TideReply, or get started and choose your plan.
  4. Approve this site. The chat is live, and with WooCommerce active, order-status answers switch on automatically.

Pricing

The plugin is free. TideReply is a paid service: one plan with every feature and unlimited teammates, with a 14-day money-back guarantee. See current prices at tidereply.com/pricing.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.3 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A TideReply account and plan (tidereply.com)
  • WooCommerce is optional – only needed for order-status answers

External services

This plugin connects to TideReply (app.tidereply.com), a third-party service operated by Evorbi:

  1. It loads the chat widget script https://app.tidereply.com/widget.js on your site’s front end. When visitors use the chat, their messages and the page URL are sent to TideReply to generate answers.
  2. During setup, the plugin exchanges a one-time connection code at https://app.tidereply.com/api/wordpress/connect/exchange (or /manual), sending your site URL, REST API base URL, WordPress and plugin versions, and whether WooCommerce is active.
  3. If WooCommerce is active, TideReply’s servers call back into your site (/wp-json/tidereply/v1/order-status, HMAC-authenticated) when a visitor asks about their own order. The request carries the order number and email the visitor typed; the response contains order status, tracking and total only – never names or addresses.
  4. On disconnect or deactivation, the plugin notifies https://app.tidereply.com/api/wordpress/connect/disconnect.

Terms of service: https://tidereply.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://tidereply.com/privacy
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “TideReply”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. Click “Connect TideReply” in the notice (or go to Settings > TideReply and click “Connect to TideReply”)
  5. Sign in to TideReply, or get started and choose your plan, then approve this site. The chat is now live.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Settings > TideReply, click “Connect to TideReply”, then approve

If the Connect button does not work on your host

Use the manual setup on the same settings screen: paste the API key from your TideReply dashboard (Settings, Widget) and click “Connect with API key”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid plan?

Yes. The plugin is free, and the chat runs on TideReply, which is a paid service with a 14-day money-back guarantee. If your TideReply workspace has no plan yet, connecting asks you to choose one first, so the chat never goes on your site without working.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes. The chat widget works on any WordPress site. WooCommerce only adds the order-status answers.

What data is sent to TideReply?

Visitor chat messages and the page URL (to answer questions), plus the connection metadata listed under External services. Order-status requests are answered by your own site; only status, tracking and total are returned.

How do I remove it?

Click Disconnect on the settings page (or deactivate the plugin). Uninstalling deletes every option the plugin created.

Is the order lookup secure?

Yes. Requests are authenticated with a per-site secret (HMAC over the exact request bytes, 5-minute replay window), the order-to-email match happens on your server, and mismatches are indistinguishable from not-found to the person asking.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • After activation, a notice on the Dashboard and Plugins screens says how to connect (dismissible).
  • The settings screen says what connecting involves and that TideReply is a paid service.
  • Clear messages when a workspace has no plan yet, or the site is connected to another workspace.
  • A connect request now stays valid for an hour, so signing up in between no longer expires it.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: one-click connect, widget injection, WooCommerce order-status endpoint.
